title: lithocarpus randaiensis
intro: Lithocarpus randaiensis, commonly known as Taiwanese Bur oak, is a species of evergreen tree in the beech family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to lower cholesterol levels and prevent cardiovascular diseases. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus randaiensis include its ability to calm the nervous system, reducing stress and anxiety, and its antimicrobial properties, which aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
